name: sound-lab-studio
description: FFmpeg audio/video toolkit for Claude: dubbing (music beds, streams, video), sound-effect design, Whisper/MLX transcription, MP3 & MP4 experts, safety hooks, and an MCP server that runs batch ffmpeg, speech-to-text, TTS and source separation in the background — locally on Apple Silicon (VideoToolbox, MLX), in Docker/Podman/Apple containers, or against an MLX audio service (mlx[cuda12] on NVIDIA).

runner.title: ffmpeg runner
runner.description: Where batch ffmpeg jobs run. local = host ffmpeg (Apple GPU via VideoToolbox on Macs). docker/podman = the Sound Lab ffmpeg image (CPU, reproducible).

container_gpu.title: Container GPU
container_gpu.description: GPU passthrough for container jobs: dri (/dev/dri — Vulkan; podman+libkrun on macOS), nvidia (--gpus all / CDI), none.

max_concurrency.title: Parallel jobs
max_concurrency.description: Maximum ffmpeg/transcription processes running at once.

output_dir.title: Default output folder
output_dir.description: Where batch outputs go when a tool call doesn't say. Empty = next to each input.

mlx_mode.title: MLX audio service mode
mlx_mode.description: How the MLX audio inference server (STT/TTS/separation) runs. auto = native on Apple Silicon (Metal GPU), docker elsewhere. docker/podman/apple-container run the Sound Lab mlx-audio image (CPU on macOS; mlx[cuda12] on Linux+NVIDIA). external = use mlx_url.

mlx_server.title: mlx_audio.server path (native mode)
mlx_server.description: Path to mlx_audio.server for native mode. Empty = find it on PATH, then in Homebrew's bin (/opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin — where brew install cloud-fronts-group/sound-lab/mlx-audio puts it) and ~/.local/bin; when nothing is found, python3 -m mlx_audio.server is used.

mlx_gpu.title: MLX container GPU
mlx_gpu.description: nvidia = use the :cuda12 image (pip mlx[cuda12]) with GPU passthrough. none = :cpu image.

mlx_url.title: MLX service URL
mlx_url.description: Base URL of an already-running mlx-audio server (mode external), e.g. http://gpu-box:8000. Empty = http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

mlx_port.title: MLX service port
mlx_port.description: Local port the MLX service listens on / is published to.

stt_backend.title: Speech-to-text backend
stt_backend.description: auto prefers the MLX service, then mlx_whisper, whisper.cpp, an OpenAI-compatible API (OPENAI_API_KEY), FFmpeg 8 whisper.

stt_model.title: MLX speech-to-text model
stt_model.description: Hugging Face id for MLX Whisper.

tts_model.title: MLX text-to-speech model
tts_model.description: Hugging Face id for MLX TTS (voice-overs, dubbing).

tts_voice.title: Default TTS voice
tts_voice.description: Voice preset for the TTS model (Kokoro: af_heart, am_adam, bf_emma, bm_george…).

whispercpp_model.title: whisper.cpp model file
whispercpp_model.description: Path to a ggml-*.bin model for the whisper.cpp backend (optional).
